blockers.message: native executable emission is not implemented yet
host boundary builtins need a native runtime ABI before AOT can preserve check/run behavior

recommended_next_steps: freeze the MIR subset for a single-file i32 main AOT prototype
keep axc run as the semantic reference while native output is pending
when packages are present, require axc lock <project> --check before AOT planning

notes: This build currently emits frontend and midend stable artifacts.
LLVM AOT v0 may emit a textual LLVM IR artifact for the current single-file MIR subset.
